in_sanskrit.name: पल्लव
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Pallab comes from the Sanskrit word पल्लव (pallava), which is derived from the roots पल् (pal) meaning lotus and लव (lava) meaning stalk or bud. The name thus signifies the bud or stalk of a lotus.

in_hindi.name: पल्लब
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Pallab is also used in Hindi, where it translates to 'the shoot of a leaf' or 'the bud of a lotus'. The Hindi meaning is पत्ता का शूत (pattā kā shūt) or लोतुस के फूलों का बुद (lotus ke phūlōn kā bud).
